scene_description: The Sounds of Life paperback lies flat, cover upward, inside a wooden cubby with empty compartments beside it. Its front page edge is set back from the shelf lip. Other books and papers are visible in the row below.

vlm_input.question: Given the image and the task, robot, and status context, what should the human change, if anything, to prevent or resolve problems with this interaction? Return only a JSON object containing an ordered guidance_specs array; use an empty array if no intervention is needed.
vlm_input.task_context: The robot will collect The Sounds of Life paperback and carry it to a reading table.
vlm_input.robot_context: The robot has one claw gripper with parallel jaws and manipulates one object at a time. It approaches the book front edge with a horizontal parallel-jaw grasp, one jaw above and one below the book. It cannot wedge its lower jaw between a book lying flush and the shelf, or switch to a side grasp.

guidance_specs.target_object: white-covered The Sounds of Life paperback lying flat by itself in the middle wooden cubby
constraints: Keep the book flat with most of its base supported by the shelf
Stop with only enough overhang for the lower jaw
Do not let the book fall from the shelf
guidance_specs.context: Slide the book toward the camera so its front edge projects slightly beyond the shelf lip for the lower jaw.

review.problem: The book rests flat with its front edge behind the shelf lip, so the lower jaw cannot get underneath for the specified grasp.
review.rationale: A short outward slide exposes an underside grasp region while keeping most of the book supported.
